messages:
sara: quick sync: two enterprise prospects insist on deterministic tail SLOs and an automatic model fallback chain. competitor announced similar. parity or differentiate?

alex: clarify: single-call runtime guarantee or best-effort + async retry? sales says single-call guarantee.

mohit: confirmed. they want high-quality -> quantized -> smaller model in one request.

julia: infra hit: synchronous fallback complicates batching and KV cache. rerouting mid-request may require KV rebuild or invalidation. need strict time budget to avoid p99 blowups.

danny: two deals will stall without a fallback+SLA story. aim for parity for now, design for richer policy later.

sara: plan: MVP parity: add `fallback_chain` per-route, synchronous hop within timeout, explicit guarantees (only for pinned/dedicated capacity). Differentiator: policy templates, simulated cost/latency preview, soft-SLAs.

alex: MVP acceptance: API allows `fallback_chain: [modelA, modelA-quant, modelB]`; runtime tries models in order within per-request timeout; benchmark p95 <300ms on medium workload; no KV corruption.

julia: infra guardrails: max fallback hops=3; per-request budget default 600ms; telemetry tags for hop index + sampled payloads.

mohit: quality risk: quant/smaller models may hallucinate more. add eval gate: degrade <2.5% on prompt set, otherwise mark as `low-quality-fallback` in headers.

danny: legal + sales: need SLA wording and rollback playbook. clarify scope: SLO only for pinned clusters or dedicated nodes.

sara: timeline: MVP parity ~4w infra +2w QA/docs; Differentiator +8-12w. recommend ship MVP this quarter, spike differentiator.

alex: add per-tenant opt-out and kill-switch; feature flag gating and gradual rollout.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: create FF `deterministic_fallback_v1`, add quota for fallback calls, set `fallback_sample_rate=0.05`, add tracing hooks, canary in us-west-2.

sara: owners: alex=API spec+PR; julia=guardrails/runbook+rollout; mohit=quality evals; danny=sales one-pager+legal draft. I'll book 30m sign-off Fri.

alex: opening spec PR today.

mohit: running evals, will post results tomorrow.

julia: drafting runbook and rollback steps.

danny: prepping customer comms.

sara: goal: ship parity to close deals, then build differentiator UX next quarter. :rocket:
